<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Fifth Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><br /></span>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>趁火打劫</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(chèn
huǒ dǎ jié)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Loot
a Burning House</i></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">A
country so beset with internal conflict that it is unable to contend
with an outside threat is open to attack.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">In
the days leading up to the Battle of Gaixia (202 B.C.), both Chu and
Han forces were exhausted by a lengthy siege, and agreed to a peace
treaty. Once the overly tired Chu began their retreat from Han
territory, Generals Han Xin (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">韩信</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
231-196 B.C.) and Zhang Liang (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">张良</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
251-186 B.C.) made the following suggestion to Emperor Liu Bang (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">刘邦</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
256-195 B.C.) of Han: "We already control half of the Empire.
Even within Chu, many governors prefer that we rule, and will not
support Xiang Yu (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">项羽</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,</span></p>
<p class="western" style="break-before: page; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; page-break-before: always; text-decoration: none;">
 <span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">236
- 202 B.C.) unless forced to. The men of Chu are tired and short of
food. The heaven's have decided to end Xiang Yu's reign. If we let
Xiang Yu escape, it is like allowing a tiger to live that it may kill
its owner later. We must strike now and end this threat." After
some meditation, Liu Bang gave the order and Xiang Yu was taken down
and, eventually, the Chu with him [18], [29].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, serif;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Loot
a Burning House</span></i></span> is associated with the 43rd
hexagram, <i>Lake over Sky</i>. The yin line in the topmost position
is being pushed out. One interpretation is that, while an internal
conflict exists (as Yin is inherently internally conflicted), one may
take advantage [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," /> <br /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span><span style="color: #333333;"> </span>

<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," />

<br /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333;"> </span><span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span>


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 5:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section54" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	<span style="font-size: large;">1) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这些形状是什么颜色的？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">正方形是红色的，三角形是蓝色</span>
    </span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;的，还有圆形是黄色的。</span></span></span></span>
    </span>
    </div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">2)<span style="font-family: times;">
	<span><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">你快要上学</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">了</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">。</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们需要买一些东西，</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;例如：笔记本，铅笔，钢笔，一台电脑。</span></span>
    </span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在山上，手机用不了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: On the mountain, cell
	phones are of no use.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4</span></span><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">火太小了，我们需要更多木头。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的家人都有手机，除了我。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: All of family have
	cell phones, except me.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们有很大的家庭。我有：两个哥哥，一</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;个姐姐，两个妹妹，还有一个弟弟。</span></span>
    </div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">爷爷是我爸爸的爸爸，奶奶是我爸爸的妈</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;妈。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的家里现在没有电。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">9</span></span><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span> </span><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">谁被打了？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">10</span></span><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">那个小店被人打劫了，有人趁机拿走了</span></span>
    <span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;东西。</span></span></span>
    </div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11)   <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那是和阿叔叔姨的笔记本。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	12)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别吃这个因为你的胃不好。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">13</span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">它的膀子和腿是木头做的，</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="zh-CN">
	</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">但是它的手</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;指还有手指是钢做的。</span></span></span>
    </div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他的眼睛和嘴很大。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别用力，除非你需要这样。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">16</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">你喜不喜欢吃牛舌（头）？</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333;"> </span><span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"></p>
